name: Track action effects
when: A scene operation has changed the available observations.
procedure: Record the edited object and the intended transformation in the public interaction history.
Compare the updated observation with the pre-edit observation, including nearby objects.
Base the next decision on the updated scene rather than the original arrangement.
verification: The next proposed edit is consistent with the observed effect of the last action.
failure_lessons: An executed command is not proof that its intended geometric effect occurred.
adaptation_notes: Original operation-specific card based on closed-loop benchmark workflows.
